title: kate-core: dedent a bare Python else
summary: python_newline drops one unit for a bare else, elif, except, or finally. A colon still adds one unit. The test goes in the existing indent tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: pub fn python_newline(buf: &TextBuffer, at: Offset, config: &DocumentConfig) -> String

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: indent.rs is a private module of workspace.rs. Its one test module is mod tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Edit two places. In the first if of python_newline, add && !ends_with_colon(&prefix) after is_dedent_word. The exact condition is !is_comment_line(&prefix) && is_dedent_word(&prefix, indent) && !ends_with_colon(&prefix). In is_dedent_word, add else, elif, except, and finally to the matches list. Leave return, pass, break, continue, and raise in that list. Do not rewrite the find call in is_dedent_word. Do not use the ? operator there. The function returns bool. Do not touch newline_for_indenter, newline_insertion, indent_lines, unindent_lines, is_comment_line, ends_with_colon, without_one_unit, or remove_unit. The existing return tests stay green. Add a_bare_else_drops_one_indent in that same module. Use python_inserted and DocumentConfig::default. Four spaces and else returns a newline. Four spaces and else: returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces and elif x: returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces and except: returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces and finally: returns a newline and eight spaces. Four spaces, hash, space, and else returns a newline and four spaces. def f(): still returns a newline and four spaces. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::a_bare_else_drops_one_indent
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. Four spaces and else returns a newline and four spaces. After the change it returns a newline. Four spaces and else: returns a newline and eight spaces. elif, except, and finally with a colon do the same. A comment that contains else keeps four spaces. def f(): still adds four spaces.
